name: LUNEX University
summary: Private health and sport university in Differdange; five bachelor's taught in English, from physiotherapy to sport management, applied for all year.

ib.text: School diploma plus English at B2; your IB may need recognition by Luxembourg's authorities (LUNEX helps). An online English and/or science test decides direct entry or a pre-bachelor foundation course first.

notes: LUNEX says that to practise as a physiotherapist you must also complete a Master in Physiotherapy; the bachelor's alone is not enough.
Physiotherapy starts in April and October; the other four start in October.
Tuition is charged monthly and rises each year, and a one-off registration fee of €695 applies (2026 intake).
